verdict.rationale: Dagster provides a Python SDK (dagster package, asset decorators), a CLI (dg/create-dagster), and explicit AI-native tooling: an official MCP server for Dagster+ and a maintained 'dagster-expert' AI skill giving coding agents context/patterns for building Dagster projects. This directly supports AI-native developers building against official SDKs with agent-aware tooling. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the AI skill and MCP server working well in practice, and no public OpenAPI spec was found (probe shows 404s) which would further support programmatic/agentic access.
